violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Accordion Safety Gates (26 TAC §747.2315(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Accordion Safety Gates
violation_type.typical_finding: During a visit on 10/31/2022, accordion safety gates which are prohibited in childcare home were used as barriers that separates the children's area from the family bedrooms and the kitchen.

finding_variants.text: During a visit on 10/31/2022, accordion safety gates which are prohibited in childcare home were used as barriers that separates the children's area from the family bedrooms and the kitchen.
There was an accordant gate being used in one of the areas that children are cared for. This was corrected at the inspection when the provider removed the gate.
A sleeping infant was in a play yard with a blanket and bouncy chair.
The infant cribs were observed to have a mesh bumper pad strapped on. This was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver removed the bumper pads.
